_title: Lab 6: Conditional probability with Kerala rainfall and floods

criteria.code: Each task attempted, runs without error, uses the required functions, and its printed output matches expected_outputs.json.
criteria.explanation: Markdown or comment explanation covers the reference concepts for tasks that ask to explain.
criteria.documentation: Headings or comments label each task; outputs are shown; no stale errors.

tasks.T1: Load kerala.csv. Encode FLOODS as 1/0 and add indicator columns for June and July rainfall above 500 mm.
tasks.T2: Cross-tabulate floods against June rain above 500 mm. Compute P(F), P(J), P(F and J) and P(F | J).
tasks.T3: Repeat for July rain above 500 mm, and also compute P(July > 500 | F) using Bayes' rule.
